purpose: Historical E0021 checkpoint and its exact-head CI/artifact audit; does not qualify the formal increment
head: f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd
title: Compare compact SPI phase instructions with banked program storage
body:
The existing coupled SHIFT_STEP changes MOSI and samples synchronized RX on the same edge. E0020's eight-word SPI mode-0 schedule therefore reads late replies too early. This increment implements two isolated phase-separated candidates and compares their real program capacity, loader compatibility and complete-chip generic cost before any production promotion.

**Production RTL remains unchanged. The broader response-envelope hypothesis for the old schedule remains FAIL; full four-mode SPI remains NOT_EVALUATED.**

| Option | Actual words / program bits | Generic cells | State bits | Legacy compatibility |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Existing, explicitly faster target | 8 / 256 | 2,793 | 410 | 17/17 PASS |
| Compact DRIVE+aux / delayed SAMPLE | 8 / 256 | 3,107 (+314) | 412 (+2) | 17/17 PASS |
| Plain DRIVE/SAMPLE + real banked loader | 10 / 320 | 3,403 (+610) | 477 (+67) | 16 PASS / 1 declared FAIL |

Both experimental phase candidates handle the same late-response oracle at the 1 MHz comparison point, retain 403 accepted edges and capture at edge 379. Compact saves 296 generic cells and 65 state bits versus this banked design. The ten-word loader allocates reserved register 5 and accepts formerly invalid lengths 9/10; the original length-nine rejection test fails and its JUnit remains FAIL. New phase encodings intentionally allocate previously invalid words in both candidates.

D22 selects compact for the **next formal qualification experiment**, keeping production `src/` unchanged. The faster-target/no-RTL alternative remains valid under the stronger declared response bound d<=88 quarter-clocks at H=25. d=89 still gives `0x69 -> 0xb4` (MSB), despite 55 ns setup; d=96 has 20 ns setup and is handled by both phased candidates. These are digital model assumptions, not real-board electrical qualification or an impossibility proof for every eight-word schedule.

### Deliverables

- [Precise encoding/timing/loader contract](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd/docs/specs/spi-phase-comparison.md).
- [Isolated reproducible implementations/runner](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/tree/f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd/experiments/spi_phase): generated copies under ignored build/, production and input hash guards, exact sources/diffs, strict JUnit checks, identical synthesis.
- [D22 decision](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd/docs/decisions/0022-compact-phase-candidate-before-promotion.md) and [E0021 evidence](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd/evidence/E0021-spi-phase-comparison/README.md), including original/curated hashes, exact test results, expected compatibility failure and initial runner/compiler failures.
- CI executes the comparison separately and retains candidate sources, patches, logs, JUnit and complete-chip generic netlists. Production proofs/collector and visualizer evidence stay separate.
- State/backlog/ledger reflect this decision. [The prior E0020 PR checkpoint](https://github.com/KG-khangelani/protocol-emulator-asic/blob/f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd/evidence/E0021-spi-phase-comparison/prior-pr11-checkpoint.json) preserves the older head's exact CI/artifact record.

### Local validation

- Doctor PASS in existing locked image; no local image build/pull, installs or cleanup.
- Final `make check` PASS: 35 Python cases plus metadata/learning/evidence checks.
- Frozen comparison: all 12 predeclared stages PASS. Each candidate passes four groups on Icarus and four on Verilator, including 519 real public-loaded/read-back transactions per run (2,076 total). Every byte, both bit orders, response corners, exact clocks/GPIO/OE/capture/HALT, invalid/mixed operations, pending freeze/reset, legacy slots, auxiliary GPIO and loader bounds are checked.
- Unmodified legacy suite: baseline 17/17, compact 17/17; banked 16/17 with exactly the predeclared failure retained. No skipped cases or warning suppressions in final runs.
- Complete-chip generic Yosys synthesis/check passes for all three; no latch/check errors. Counts include loader, program/data stores, synchronizer and executor; they are not CMOS5L mapped area/timing.
- Atlas export consistency, clean patch and all tested/protected/curated/committed Git-blob SHA-256 checks PASS.

Current head: **`f0c41fcf3aaca14a76dd0c45a23f259599de24fd`**. All five fresh exact-head remote workflows PASS. The older `463cc1e` passes remain historical.

### Scope and next step

Draft/unmerged. Main remains `ae13f6bfcfd3fe21cd937768bc9e1151f441379c`. PR8 and compiler remain deferred; no import/rebase/merge. Production RTL, official ports/config, 6x4 allocation, visualizer and learning record remain unchanged. No physical flow, hardware spend, deployment or security change.

Next: prove compact phase sequencing, pending-delay/counter boundaries, valid eighth-sample-only commit, reset/enable/loader abort and refinement of previous legal operations before considering production promotion. Experimental formal proof, full four-mode/continuous SPI, I2C, mapped/physical area/timing/Fmax and silicon remain NOT_EVALUATED; H1-H4 remain unproven. Owner M0 fluency remains PENDING independently of engineering progress.
